name: Minakami Fuyuko
source:
Akisuke's cousin. She is a college student with a bright and cheerful personality. She is a  seasoned cosplayer. In the world of cosplay, she is a little known. In Akisuke, he discovers his talent as a cosplayer (?) And plans to draw him into the world of cosplay. Previously, she was dating a boyfriend who has a cosplay hobby, and starting with cosplay H with my ex-boyfriend, She woke up to a cosplay hobby herself and continue to the present. In addition to cosplay costumes for anime and game characters, she also have plenty of costumes for cosplay ecchi such as gymnastics and bloomers.

[from Getchu]
